name: intervalImageCandidate_eq_images

theorem intervalImageCandidate_eq_images (a z T y : ℝ) :
    intervalImageCandidate a z T y =
      1 + Real.exp (-imageA a y z 1 / T) + Real.exp (-imageA a y z (-1) / T) -
        Real.exp (-imageB a y z 0 / T) - Real.exp (-imageB a y z (-1) / T) +
          ∑' n : ℕ, spatialTailBlock 0 a z T y n

        (fun s : ℝ => Shao.C2.SourceIntervalCompletion.sourceIntervalCompletion Q w s T z) y) :

name: remaining_population_geometry
head:
theorem remaining_population_geometry {n : ℕ} (a : Shao.Path n)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ n) (σ : LabelPerm n) :
    0 ≤ remainingEnergy a r σ ∧
      (remainingSum a r σ) ^ 2 ≤ ((n - r : ℕ) : ℝ) * remainingEnergy a r σ ∧
      (∀ j : Fin n, r ≤ j.val → (a (σ j)) ^ 2 ≤ remainingEnergy a r σ) ∧
      (remainingEnergy a r σ = 0 → remainingSum a r σ = 0 ∧
        ∀ j : Fin n, r ≤ j.val → a (σ j) = 0)

      ∀ w y T z : ℝ, 0 < w → 0 ≤ T → (T = 0 → y = z) →
        completionExt J (eventCompletionKernel J P) w y T z =
          eventCompletionKernel J P (w, y, T, z)

name: source_stopped_integrability
head:
theorem source_stopped_integrability {n : ℕ} (J : MonitoredDomain)
    (F G : BridgeKernel) (hFm : Measurable F) (hGm : Measurable G)
    (C : ℝ) (hK : KernelBounds J F G C)
    (P : Measure (Shao.Path n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (ν : Shao.Path n → LabelPerm n → ℕ)
    (hνm : ∀ σ, Measurable (fun a => ν a σ)) (hνbound : ∀ a σ, ν a σ ≤ n)
    (m : Shao.Path n → ℝ) (hmm : Measurable m) (hmb : ∀ a, |m a| ≤ 1) :
    Integrable (fun p : Shao.Path n × LabelPerm n =>
      m p.1 * sourceValue J F p.1 x (ν p.1 p.2) p.2) (revealLaw P) ∧
    Integrable (fun p : Shao.Path n × LabelPerm n =>
      m p.1 * sourceValue J F p.1 x 0 p.2) (revealLaw P) ∧
    Integrable (fun p : Shao.Path n × LabelPerm n =>
      m p.1 * stoppedRemainderSum J F G p.1 x (ν p.1) p.2) (revealLaw P)

name: source_masked_stopped_telescope_integral
head:
theorem source_masked_stopped_telescope_integral {n : ℕ} (J : MonitoredDomain)
    (F G : BridgeKernel) (hFm : Measurable F) (hGm : Measurable G)
    (C : ℝ) (hK : KernelBounds J F G C)
    (P : Measure (Shao.Path n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (H : ℝ) (hH : 0 < H)
    (ν : Shao.Path n → LabelPerm n → ℕ)
    (hνm : ∀ σ, Measurable (fun a => ν a σ))
    (hν : ∀ a, IsRevealStoppingRank (ν a))
    (hcap : ∀ a σ, ν a σ ≤ energyCutoff a H σ)
    (m : Shao.Path n → ℝ) (hmm : Measurable m) (hmb : ∀ a, |m a| ≤ 1) :
    (∫ p : Shao.Path n × LabelPerm n,
      m p.1 * sourceValue J F p.1 x (ν p.1 p.2) p.2 ∂revealLaw P) -
    (∫ p : Shao.Path n × LabelPerm n,
      m p.1 * sourceValue J F p.1 x 0 p.2 ∂revealLaw P) =
    ∫ p : Shao.Path n × LabelPerm n,
      m p.1 * stoppedRemainderSum J F G p.1 x (ν p.1) p.2 ∂revealLaw P

name: finite_second_scalar_closed_cdf_budget
head:
theorem finite_second_scalar_closed_cdf_budget :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
        (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n),
        Integrable (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2) mu →
        (∫ z : ℝ, z ∂mu) = 0 →
        (0 < ∫ z : ℝ, z ^ 2 ∂mu) →
        let sigma : ℝ := Real.sqrt (∫ z : ℝ, z ^ 2 ∂mu)
        let normalizedLaw : Measure ℝ := Measure.map
          (fun z : ℝ => z / (sigma * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))) mu
        let R : ℝ := Shao.truncationBudget normalizedLaw n 0
        let P : Measure (Shao.Path n) := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => mu)
        let W : Shao.Path n → ℝ := Shao.C1.normalizedEndpoint
        ∀ v : ℝ,
          |P.real {a : Shao.Path n | W a ≤ v} -
            (gaussianReal 0 1).real (Set.Iic v)| ≤ C * R

name: source_selected_remainder_decomposition
head:
theorem source_selected_remainder_decomposition
    {n : ℕ} (J : MonitoredDomain) (F G : BridgeKernel)
    (a : Shao.Path n) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x)
    (ν : LabelPerm n → ℕ) (r : ℕ) (σ : LabelPerm n) :
    (if r < ν σ then sourceRemainder J F G a x r σ else 0) =
      sourceRetainedRemainder J F G a x ν r σ +
      sourceSeparatedOvershoot J G a x ν r σ

name: source_parts_measurable_integrable
head:
theorem source_parts_measurable_integrable
    {n : ℕ} (J : MonitoredDomain) (F G : BridgeKernel)
    (hFm : Measurable F) (hGm : Measurable G)
    (C : ℝ) (hK : KernelBounds J F G C)
    (P : Measure (Shao.Path n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (ν : Shao.Path n → LabelPerm n → ℕ)
    (hνm : ∀ σ, Measurable (fun a => ν a σ)) :
    (∀ (σ : LabelPerm n) (r : ℕ),
      Measurable (fun a => sourceRetainedRemainder J F G a x (ν a) r σ) ∧
      Measurable (fun a => sourceSeparatedOvershoot J G a x (ν a) r σ)) ∧
    (∀ r : ℕ,
      Integrable (fun p : Shao.Path n × LabelPerm n =>
        sourceRetainedRemainder J F G p.1 x (ν p.1) r p.2) (revealLaw P) ∧
      Integrable (fun p : Shao.Path n × LabelPerm n =>
        sourceSeparatedOvershoot J G p.1 x (ν p.1) r p.2) (revealLaw P)) ∧
    Integrable (fun p : Shao.Path n × LabelPerm n =>
      retainedSum J F G p.1 x (ν p.1) p.2) (revealLaw P) ∧
    Integrable (fun p : Shao.Path n × LabelPerm n =>
      separatedSum J G p.1 x (ν p.1) p.2) (revealLaw P)

name: source_separated_overshoot_sign_domination
head:
theorem source_separated_overshoot_sign_domination
    {n : ℕ} (P : Measure BridgeNoise) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (G : MonitoredDomain → BridgeKernel)
    (hDeriv : ∀ (J : MonitoredDomain) (w y T z : ℝ),
      0 < w → 0 < T → Interior J w y → Interior J w z →
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => eventCompletionKernel J P (w, s, T, z))
        (G J (w, y, T, z)) y)
    (a : Shao.Path n) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x)
    (ν : LabelPerm n → ℕ) (r : ℕ) (σ : LabelPerm n) :
    let Oplus : ℝ := sourceSeparatedOvershoot .upper (G .upper) a x ν r σ
    let Ominus : ℝ := sourceSeparatedOvershoot .lower (G .lower) a x ν r σ
    let Ointerval : ℝ := sourceSeparatedOvershoot .interval (G .interval) a x ν r σ
    0 ≤ Oplus ∧ 0 ≤ Ominus ∧ Ointerval ≤ Oplus + Ominus ∧
      max Ointerval 0 ≤ Oplus + Ominus ∧ 0 ≤ Oplus + Ominus - Ointerval
